paragraphs: Rabbi Yohanan, son of Rabbi Yose ben Kisma.

Hyman cites Midrash Tehillim, chapter 114, for the teaching attributed to him that Eliezer’s name has the numerical value 318, from which he concludes that only Avraham’s servant Eliezer accompanied him in the war against the kings. Hyman reports that the older Midrash Tehillim lacks the words ben Kisma.

notes.text: The older Midrash Tehillim, according to Hyman, lacks ben Kisma. The gematria interpretation and the claim that only Eliezer accompanied Avraham are the notice’s account.

The supplied citation reads Psalm 114. The matching exposition is found under Psalm 110. One transcription of section 4 names Yochanan son of Rabbi Yose ben Kisma and gives 318 explicitly. The OYW text calls him Yochanan son of Rabbi Yose and refers to the numerical value of Eliezer’s name.
